text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing, Vivlos and 
I went to see a theater play together.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Rich celebrities need to be well-versed in 
the arts and stuff like this, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I usually just end up watching for 
fun—which is why I called you over today, 
Teach ♡"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Nǐ hǎo! Thanks for inviting me, Vivlos♪ 
This play has been getting quite a lot of 
buzz, hasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I was just wanting to see it! Thank you so 
much for this wonderful opportunity♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thank YOU! Aha, watching it together with 
everyone is so exciting!♡

text_block_list.name: Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
""And so, the winged Umamusume offered 
seven crowns unto the heavens...""

text_block_list.name: Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
"And so, she galloped away into the vast, 
open sky—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—Waaah, that was so super good! I'm 
totally touched!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what happened after that? After 
the protagonist ran off toward the 
horizon...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I think you're free to interpret it 
however you like. Just as you felt it, 
Vivlos-san.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I see...! In that case—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"'I hope a child who looks up to the 
protagonist will dream the same dream one 
day...' —There."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufu, what a wonderful impression♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's so nice to be able to share what 
you're feeling right away. That's the real 
beauty of social media.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
! Alrighty-right♡ Can I share what I just 
felt, then?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I wanna take a picture with everyone who 
shared this moving moment!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No, no! You get in here too, Train-chi~! 
Taking a selfie... Yaaay! â¡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after parting ways with Satono Crown 
and the others, Vivlos continues to look 
delighted.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Aaaah, that was super fun!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I de-finitely wanna go again♪ Find 
another popular one for me~—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Wait, ...W-Whaaaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The UmaSta post I made earlier is totally 
blowing up! I guess it really was a buzzy 
play...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Look—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"They all get along so well, so cute♡" 
"Seeing Vivlos at the theater is kind of 
unexpected!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder what they're gonna talk 
about..." "Hope you post more pics of you 
guys hanging out!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Wait, maybe nobody's talking about 
the play??
choice_data_list: It's all about Vivlos, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why? When we went to the 
observation deck—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
People kept saying things like "Looks like 
fun!" and "I want to go with you!"—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: B... By any chance, Trainie...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Both back then and now... Rather than 
trendy hot spots, everyone—
choice_data_list:
Everyone just wants to get to know you 
better.
Everyone wants to know the real you.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh~~~?! Even more than the photo spots 
or the amazing play?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...D-Doesn't that, doesn't that mean—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: That's totally love right there!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I could totally feel everyone's love! ♡ I 
mean, it means they're "admiring" me, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I want everyone to get to know muuuuch 
more about me too! ♡
choice_data_list: Let's aim for a post like that!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I want everyone to get to know muuuuch 
more about me too! ♡
choice_data_list: Let's aim for a post like that!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I definitely will!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Who I'm besties with~, what's super fun~♡ 
Aha, so much to write down♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What should I write first~?" And so, 
Vivlos immediately got to planning.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yay~! I'm counting on you♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: You understand me sooo well, Trainie♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I resolved to give it my all so as not to 
betray this trust.
